design: Three independent paraphrases of the instruction VOICE/TAIL (experiments/ablation/prompt_paraphrase.py), deepseek-v4, 200 briefs, 1 seed each, normalized, scored with the canonical paired machinery
reading: Every paraphrase lands DeepSeek instruction at or past the human level on B_n (medians -0.026 to -0.030, one significant), against the canonical wording's 0.000; the landing point moves by about 0.03 with wording.
caveats: paraphrase legs are 1-sample (canonical is 3-sample seed-averaged); one model
